claim: Ceramide levels rise along the frailty module trajectory before clinical frailty.
plan: Comparator: participants with versus without repeat draws. Measurement: `Cer(d18:1/16:0)` across draws. Falsification: no association of module trajectory with ceramide change.
alternatives: Statin use lowers ceramides and confounds the trajectory.
evidence: Cross-sectional support, longitudinal null in ARIC (PMC7806657); Paperclip run https://paperclip.gxl.ai/evidence/r/NKELhoKDvYGlt8k8
critique: Needs repeat draws; HbA1c and T2D status are confounders.

resolvability.missing: Whether participants have repeat metabolomics draws.
resolvability.note: Species found; draw structure not profiled.

claim: Within-person ceramide change tracks change in the black module eigengene.
plan: Comparator: within-person change between draws. Measurement: `Cer(d18:1/16:0)` and `Cer(d18:1/24:0)` ratio change. Falsification: ratio change uncorrelated with eigengene change.
evidence: Released summary results/abc123_ceramide__summary.csv cited, values not restated.
critique: Sharper and falsifiable; v2 depends on repeat draws.
